grapple.name: GRAPPLE HOOK
grapple.text: TAP A HOOK POST TO HAUL THE PARTY UP ONTO A HIGH LEDGE.

tide.name: TIDE CHARM
tide.text: THE PARTY CAN NOW SWIM THROUGH DEEP WATER.

lantern.name: LANTERN OF EMBERS
lantern.text: DARK CAVES ARE NOW LIT AROUND YOU.

lens.name: SEER'S LENS
lens.text: FALSE WALLS SHIMMER AND HIDDEN BRIDGES APPEAR. SHADES CAN'T HIDE FROM YOU.

gauntlets.name: STONE GAUNTLETS
gauntlets.text: HEAVY BOULDERS SHIFT AND REINFORCED WALLS BREAK. ROCK ARMOUR CRACKS UNDER YOUR BLOWS.

claws.name: CLIMBING CLAWS
claws.text: TAP A CLIFF FACE SCORED WITH CLAW MARKS TO CLIMB IT, UP OR DOWN.

cloak.name: GALE CLOAK
cloak.text: TAP A WIND VENT TO CATCH THE UPDRAFT AND GLIDE ACROSS A CHASM OR OFF A LEDGE.
